 Order

The present petition is filed for direction to the tribunal under Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, 1957, for timely adjudication of the case pending before the Tribunal in the matter of assessment of appropriate/suitable compensation for the land acquired from the petitioner.

entities.text: Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition and Development) Act, 1957
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. It is contended by counsel for the petitioner that the proceedings are pending before the tribunal since 2021 and the matter is being continuously fixed for final argument since 24/04/2025, but since last almost one year, the final argument have not been heard by the said tribunal and therefore, the disposal of the matter is getting delayed.

3. Considering the aforesaid and considering the position that since 24/04/2025, the matter is being fixed for final arguments, therefore, the Tribunal is directed to decide the matter on its own merits within a period of 2 MP-1880-2026 2 months from the date of production of copy of this order.
4. With the aforesaid direction, the petition is disposed of.
